“উতিষ্ঠত জাগ্ৰত” (Arise, awake, and move forward towards success and enlightenment), Goreswar College has successfully completed 50 years of its glorious existence since 1974. Established in 1974 on the serene north bank of the mighty River Brahmaputra, and situated in the heart of the newly formed Tamulpur District under the Bodoland Territorial Council, the college has emerged as a centre of academic excellence, discipline, and value-based education.  It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to Goreswar College, a premier institution of higher education along with fulfilling the aspirations of the students in the Higher Secondary level (Arts & Commerce). The College has three streams in the degree course- Arts, Science and Commerce.  Since its inception, the college has been dedicated to spreading quality education among the students of rural & tribal dominated areas, and contributing to the intellectual, social, and cultural development of the region. Our institution continuously strives to nurture young minds through innovative teaching-learning practices, co-curricular activities, research orientation, and community engagement.
The College envisions becoming a centre of excellence in higher education by empowering students with knowledge, skills, moral values, and social responsibility for building a progressive and inclusive society.
At Goreswar College, we believe that education is not merely the acquisition of degrees but the shaping of character and the awakening of human potential. With the dedicated efforts of our faculty members, staff, students, alumni, and stakeholders, we continue to move forward with confidence and commitment toward excellence.
I invite students, parents, academicians, and visitors to explore our institution and become part of our journey of knowledge, growth, and service to society.
With best wishes,
Dr.Prativa Patowary
Principal
About The College
Goreswar College is the sole premier institute of Higher Education in the North-eastern part of Baska District, Assam. It was established on the 29th day of August 1974 by a team of selfless and untiring social workers and lovers of education of the greater Goreswar locality. Betna Siksha and Krishi Unayan Sangha (Betna Education and Agriculture Development Organization) was a major pioneering force in the venture that provided funds to develop the required initial infrastructure for the college after it had functioned from temporary sites for some time at the beginning. Started as an Arts College with the P.U. (pre-university now Higher Secondary) course in 1974 with 116 students, it rose to the status of a Degree College in and from the session 1977-78 as per G.U. Order No.-Aff/cg/1/77 with its P.U. (now H.S.) program still continued. The College was brought under Deficit system of Grants–in–Aid with effect from 1.9.81 as per Govt. of Assam, Director of Public Instructions’ Order No.NC.G (A)RC-2/82/17 dated Kahilipara, the 22nd July 1982. Again the College was provincialised w.e.f. 1st December 2005 by the Govt. of Assam along with other Deficit system of Grants-in-Aid Degree Colleges...
